Malcolm, 2026-10-08: 'lets create a modern medical style explainer image to go with this section: Do Collagen Creams Work?' on the Collagen Skincare rebuild (preview /pages/collagen-skin-plumping?view=collagen-skincare, section `answer`, which becomes a media-with-text with this image beside the text). Style: the store's medical explainer set (block-brightening-multi-pathway-r2, block-copper-peptide-research-medical-r3): glossy high-key CGI skin block in cross-section, warm generic skin tones, no text.

=== WHAT THIS FRAME MUST ARGUE, AND NOTHING MORE ===

The section's answer: collagen in a cream works as a moisturizer. Native and soluble collagen are far too large to cross intact skin, so they lie on the surface as a film that locks in moisture; hydrolyzed collagen is cut into small pieces, and some of it reaches the skin's outer layer, where it helps hold water. So the picture shows THREE SIZES OF THE SAME CREAM-WHITE MATERIAL AT THREE DEPTHS, ALL OF THEM AT OR NEAR THE SURFACE: long thick triple-stranded cables lying ON TOP of the skin as a continuous film; shorter rods of the same cable just under the top pads; and small short fragments inside the quilted top layer, each holding a clear water droplet. Below the top layer NOTHING of the cream material appears.

IT MUST NOT SHOW ANY OF THE MATERIAL PASSING BELOW THE TOP LAYER. A diagram that shows collagen or peptides reaching the deeper layers makes a penetration claim the registers forbid (memory an-image-can-make-a-claim; collagen register: 'far too large to cross intact skin'; Matrixyl register: 'penetrates deep into the dermis' is on the avoid list). The deep layers are drawn intact and undisturbed, with no arrows, no glow and no new fibres forming there.

NO BEFORE-AND-AFTER, NO LEFT-TO-RIGHT PROGRESSION: the film covers the whole width evenly. No face, no product, no text (labels are composited later if needed; the live block carries no label).

GEOMETRY: the answer section's media box on the preview is a square at 1440 (media-with-text, image beside three short paragraphs), so the master is square 2048x2048 and the block is inset with modelled ends, exactly as the brightening explainer. CLASS B, no reference images. All six suppliers, two candidates each, three slot variants, 36 candidates. Malcolm picks by underscore; never shortlist. Remember `set -a` before sourcing credentials. FLUX.2 prints digits on glassware: check its candidates at full size.

slots.title: A · Three sizes at three depths: film on top, rods under the pads, fragments holding droplets inside the top layer
slots.prompt:
Luxury medical explainer illustration for premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy three-dimensional CGI, immaculate, high-key, lit with soft even diffuse light. Square format. Warm generic skin tones throughout - peach, blush, cream and pale pink - on a smooth warm cream background gradient, faintly glowing.

A rectangular block of skin is shown in cross-section SQUARE TO THE CAMERA, a straight-on front elevation with no perspective and no turn, the cut face exactly parallel to the picture plane, edges horizontal. The top surface is seen only as the thinnest sliver along its upper edge.

THE BLOCK DOES NOT TOUCH THE SIDES OF THE FRAME. It sits inset, occupying about four fifths of the frame's width, with clear empty background to its left and to its right. ITS LEFT AND RIGHT ENDS ARE FULLY MODELLED AND VISIBLE: every layer finishes in a rounded, three-dimensional end face rather than a flat slice - the packed spheres end as whole rounded spheres, the thin plates end with a softly rounded edge that shows their thickness, the deep lobules bulge outward as complete rounded forms. The block stands on a thin clear glass plate that extends a little beyond it at both ends.

THE STACK, TOP TO BOTTOM: a quilted surface of soft rounded pads, about a sixth of the block's height; a thin cream film of fine parallel strands; a thick band of packed rounded spheres, large and clearly separate, each a distinct glossy rounded ball; a thin peach plate; a zone of pearl-ivory cables lying in loose horizontal waves; a second peach plate; two rows of large cream-blush lobules. The deep layers are calm, intact and undisturbed.

ONE MATERIAL IN THREE SIZES, ALL AT OR NEAR THE SURFACE, ACROSS THE WHOLE WIDTH OF THE BLOCK:

ON TOP OF THE SKIN: a continuous, even, translucent cream-white film made of long thick cables, each cable visibly three strands twisted together, lying flat along the surface like a soft quilt laid over the pads. The film covers the whole width evenly and sits ON the surface - it does not sink in. Beneath the film, between it and the pads, sits a thin clear sheen of held water with a few clear colourless glassy droplets caught against the underside of the film.

JUST UNDER THE SURFACE, within the quilted pads: short rods of the same three-stranded cable, a few at a time, cut to perhaps a quarter of the film cables' length, nestled between the top pads only.

INSIDE THE QUILTED TOP LAYER: small short fragments of the same material, each tiny fragment holding one clear colourless water droplet against it, so the pads around them look swollen, plump, taut and glossy, pressed close together with no gaps, with a crisp bright specular highlight along the top of the plumped surface.

NOTHING OF THE CREAM-WHITE MATERIAL APPEARS BELOW THE QUILTED TOP LAYER. The band of spheres, the plates, the cable zone and the lobules carry none of it: no fragments, no rods, no glow, no arrows, no change.

The whole picture is calm, luxurious, clinical and clean, like a frame from a premium skincare advertisement, with nothing written anywhere.
